purpose: Reusable public historical reporting and proceeding references, not evidence of this article's allegations or recipient eligibility.

historical_context.event: SB 806 required independent enforcement monitor; reports published 2023.

Independent enforcement monitor final report documented staffing, collaboration, expert availability and resource problems. These general findings are not evidence that this particular case was mishandled.
SB 815 reforms include CLU and quality-of-care interview requirement, contingent on funded positions; Board authorization sunset January 1, 2028.
CLU established; current closure review route. Do not assume 2025 requirements applied to historical investigation.
BCSH split; DCA now sits under BCSA. Historical chain and present chain must not be conflated.
